name: R037-noland-cloyster-dive-sandstorm
why: Silver Noland (challenge number 2, full AI). Cloyster (set 371: Dive, Toxic, Double Team, Protect) is Water/Ice, the only Dive/Dig/Fly/Bounce set of the range with an Ice type; when the weather check reads sandstorm and the user is not Rock/Ground/Steel, AI_CV_SemiInvulnerable falls into the Ice-type test and the second type (Ice) encourages Dive. Noland's party is drawn by the seed, so only seeds whose Brain party holds Cloyster can hit (about 3 in 100). The player's Sandslash (set 330) raises a sandstorm, Piloswine (set 335, Ice/Ground, immune to the sand) Roars twice so Noland's Pokemon rotate while the sand is up, then Sandslash renews the sand; the cycle repeats. None of the player's Pokemon ever uses Protect (the gate before the weather test).
